newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs have stamina to reach 137.50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs have stamina to reach 137.50.

text.p: With momentum still building up, September BTP futures on LIFFE will move higher to capture uncharted territory above 137.00 on Monday, analysts said.

Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at 4CAST in London, said daily momentum indicators confirmed further gains despite overbought charts. For Monday, she saw gains limited to the psychological level of 137.50.
Further points of resistance would be provided by trendlines from early and late June coming in at 137.62, 137.86 and 138.12.
"But that would be quite ambitious for today," Jones said.
By 0740 GMT, September BTPs were 0.21 higher at 136.99.

BTPs, fuelled by expectations Italy will join a European single currency in the first wave, have scored new peaks almost daily since mid-June. In early trade on Monday, September touched a new all-time high at 137.10.
Jones saw the downside on Monday confined to 136.50 -- a trendline support level. Below there, 136.00 was the next target.

Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a note daily indicators were on the verge of crossing positively, which could suggest another move higher. If support at 136.59 held, gains could be revived through 137.05 to wave objectives near 137.49.
A breach of the uptrend near 136.59 would trigger retracement through an intermediate level at 135.41 to 135.05, they said.
But in the more medium-term, analysts saw a consolidative move extending to 134.00. The market's performance at this level would however determine the next direction.

"A breach may signal not only a short-term retracement, but may also be the early signal of much deeper retracement and...the end of this bullish phase," DMG analysts said, adding this would be confirmed by a break of 132.40.
By 0805 GMT, September Eurolira was steady at 93.38.
